errors.description: secure_msg_q is a multi-bit value produced in secure_clk and sampled directly in normal_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
doorbell_pulse_q is a one-cycle secure_clk pulse consumed directly in normal_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
doorbell_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample normal_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in normal_event_o.
access_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector access_mode_q before decoding in normal_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
secure_rst_n is used as data inside normal_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
audit_snapshot_q combines secure_clk payload state with normal_clk status state in audit_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
